R05: Verdict: BREAKING (semantic), walau diff OpenAPI 0. Dua break: (1) flip default sort `created_at DESC -> ASC` membuat feed menampilkan data terlama, cursor `N-1` lompat/duplikat item; (2) omitted -> `null` meledakkan decoder Swift/Kotlin/Go/Zod non-nullable yang membedakan presence vs null. Langkah: kembalikan default `DESC` di `v1`, jadikan ASC opt-in eksplisit (`?sort=created_at:asc`) atau `/v2`; pulihkan omission key (atau dokumentasikan `nullable` hanya di versi baru). Inventaris consumer per versi app/SDK, owner, volume request, dan apakah decoder bisa dijalankan; mobile N-2/N-3 masih aktif berbulan-bulan. Replay traffic tersanitasi per consumer ke build baru, termasuk walk pagination multi-halaman; consumer yang tak bisa di-replay = NOT_MEASURED, bukan kompatibel. Tambah contract test untuk urutan default dan presence key agar CI menangkap semantic break, bukan hanya AST diff. Jika perubahan tetap diinginkan: minta sign-off contract owner atas deploy order, umumkan dengan `Deprecation: @<unix>` + `Sunset` + `Link`, dan pantau hit legacy sampai drain sebelum memindahkan default.
R12:
Treat this as reconstruction, not conversion. Wrapping the PNG in an SVG `<image>` or shipping a raw auto-trace with thousands of noisy nodes is still a raster, not a sharp logo.

First ask for the original vector or brand file and the font name; the owner often has them.

Otherwise: inspect the 512px source (anti-aliasing, artefacts, transparency) and note that detail under about 1px cannot be recovered. Rebuild circles, straight edges, equal radii and symmetry as real primitives. Re-set text in the identified, licensed font and outline it, or redraw it; never trace letters. Run vtracer (MIT) or potrace (GPL-2.0, check licence before bundling) only as an underlay, redraw with the fewest anchors that hold the shape, then delete it. Set a `viewBox` matching the aspect ratio with deliberate padding, no fixed width/height. Sample colours from flat areas, mapped to brand tokens.

Verify: rasterize at 512px and pixel-diff against the PNG; check 16/32/64px, favicon and dark backgrounds. Report verified checks separately from assumptions (exact colours, font identity).
